instruction: In column D, record 'Pass' for marks of 50 or above, 'Fail' for marks from 1 to 49, and 'Held' where marks are '--'.

Metric verifies that each status in column D correctly follows the rule logic when applied to the corresponding mark in column C. This ensures the evaluator validates the actual logic implementation, not just hard-coded values.
